judgment.quote_A: As he climbed the spiral staircase to the lantern room, a familiar pattern was missing
judgment.quote_B: the familiar pulse was absent. The chilling wind whispered through the tower
judgment.reason: Both answers are complete, fall within the 100-140 word range, avoid the forbidden words (afraid, fear, mysterious), and effectively convey the keeper's realization of a missing light through concrete sensory details. Answer A uses rich musical metaphors and specific architectural details (spiral staircase, lantern room, moonless night), while Answer B offers a clear atmospheric narrative with strong concrete imagery (distant island, chilling wind, dark waters). Both are equally effective, faithful interpretations of the prompt.
